title: What If You Stood on Iapetus, Saturn's Two-Faced Walnut Moon?

scenes.text: What if you stood on Iapetus? One side is black, the other white as snow.
The dark half is described as black as an asphalt parking lot.
The bright half reflects light about like fresh snow, and nobody is fully sure why.
Around its equator runs a ridge at least 1,300 kilometers long, a third of the way around.
The ridge climbs up to about 20 kilometers, and it is about 20 kilometers wide.
It gives Iapetus a walnut shape. Its heavy cratering suggests the ridge is ancient.

description:
What if you stood on Iapetus?
A 20-kilometer-high ridge circles a moon with one black face and one white.
What should we run through next?
